title: Quenched Sour Jiangsu Flour Flatbread
description: A sour, crumbly flatbread flavored with rice vinegar and soy sauce, finished with melted butter for a cozy Jiangsu-inspired bite.
instructions: Combine wholemeal flour, salt, sugar, and ground ginger in a mixing bowl.
Add rice vinegar and soy sauce to the dry mix and stir to distribute liquids evenly.
Pour in water gradually while mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 5 minutes until smooth.
Form the dough into a ball, wrap it in plastic wrap, and let it rest at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Divide the rested dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a thin round.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat, melt butter in it, and pour a thin layer of melted butter over the skillet.
Cook each flatbread for about 2 minutes on each side until golden brown, then slide onto a cooling rack.
